crc_image_result_t

Validation result filled by crc_api_validate(). The structure is cleared on entry, and fields written before a failed check remain available to the caller.

Fields
calculated_crc

CRC calculated from the image when CRC calculation is reached.

actual_size

Copy of crc_image_desc_t.actual_size.

expected_size

Copy of crc_image_desc_t.expected_size.

size_valid

Nonzero only when the actual and expected sizes match and the optional maximum-size check passes.

crc_valid

Nonzero only when calculated_crc equals the expected CRC.
